units.source_text: [\[27\]](#part1330.html#w27) 谷仓院是保管京畿诸国的纳贡品和无主官田、没收官田等收获物的官库。

en.t: The Tanikura-in was an official storehouse that kept tribute goods from the provinces around the capital, as well as the harvests from ownerless government fields, confiscated government fields, and similar lands.
